tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search the Comidoc historical course catalog with topic, quality, freshness, coupon availability, repeat-course, and regular-issuer filters. Coupon capacity and remaining redemptions are always returned when known. Courses with an active coupon carry an access block: what opening the coupon requires

tools.name: fetch_course
tools.description: Fetch one course by Udemy course ID or slug, including topics, coupon history, live redemption capacity, and the access block when it has an active coupon or is free on Udemy. Each course has course_url, its Comidoc course page; coupon codes are not included.

tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Find current or historical coupon offers. Returns total, remaining, redeemed, expiry, and observation freshness. tools.name: get_filter_options
tools.description: Return the current categories, languages, levels, and canonical filter values accepted by the course and offer search filters.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Discover Comidoc topic slugs by catalog size, name, or temporal trend.

tools.name: fetch_topic
tools.description: Fetch one topic and its active-offer course count by Comidoc slug.

tools.name: get_trending_courses
tools.description: Return temporal course trends for 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days with score version, rank movement, signals, and coupon availability.

tools.name: get_trending_topics
tools.description: Return temporal topic trends for 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days with rank movement and transparent score signals.

tools.name: show_course_cards
tools.description: Display Comidoc courses as visual cards in clients that support MCP Apps: image, title, instructor, rating, duration, Udemy price and price with the coupon, coupons left, coupon end date, and language. tools.name: get_my_access
tools.description: The connected person's Comidoc Premium status: whether it is active, the plan, its renewal date, credits left, and the page where they manage it. Requires an OAuth connection with account:read; nothing sensitive is returned. Without a connection, the server answers 401 with an OAuth challenge.

tools.name: submit_coupons
tools.description: Queue up to 500 Udemy coupon links for verification, in the name of the connected person. Free. Requires an OAuth connection with coupons:submit (without one, the server answers 401 with an OAuth challenge) or a Comidoc developer key with that scope. Returns a result for each link in input order.
